ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: Custom T Shirt for Men Front Back Print Make Your Design Logo Text Gift Tshirt 100% Cotton Made in US
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Do I have to pay extra for printing?

Both front and back sideFOR FREE,but sleeve print will be extra fee for each place.

How to send the design?

Send your design through the message, and tell them your shirt size and color you want. They will make a sample for you ,if you think it's all right,just pay for it.

How about the shirt quality?

The fabric is good, not thin, but not too thick either.

Can they handle images, such as removing the background?

Usually easy to handle, they will remove the background when it is more obvious, but if it is a photo, it is generally not. Of course, unless you have special needs, please let them know.

Do I need to pay additional shipping fees if I buy multiple items?

No need, no matter how many items are, there is no need to pay additional shipping fees.

Men Size

Multiple color you can choose
